name: E05_streets
note: Street centrelines within about 600 m of the site (segments with any vertex inside a 1,200 m square), from the Beyond Data tool's streets_edm.json. Source: City of Edmonton Open Data, Road Network (downloaded 16 Oct 2026); roads and alleys; ramps, overpasses and bridges dropped. 'flag_as_stored' is an unlabelled flag in the tool data (the tool's route search treats 0 differently); not interpreted.
